all.expected_output_scope: Use all supplied pre-Claim evidence families.
all.prohibited_task_interpretation: Do not diagnose geological cause from mechanics alone.
all.purpose: Integrated construction-state review for the supplied state slice.
all.style_requirements: Concise engineering prose; no unsupported certainty.

daily_review.expected_output_scope: Daily review cell evidence and directly linked response evidence.
daily_review.prohibited_task_interpretation: Do not treat absent observations as normal.
daily_review.purpose: Review the current valid-date construction state.
daily_review.style_requirements: State only supplied evidence and uncertainty.

forward_attention.expected_output_scope: Forward attention evidence available at the knowledge boundary.
forward_attention.prohibited_task_interpretation: Do not upgrade forecast to observed fact.
forward_attention.purpose: Summarize forward-looking geological attention for the supplied slice.

metric_review.expected_output_scope: RAI, GRS, GRCI and supporting evidence when available.
metric_review.prohibited_task_interpretation: Do not express RAI/GRS/GRCI as probability.
metric_review.purpose: Review shared Stage4 attention metrics for the supplied state slice.
